Row.SpeakerTwo: Say them while the moment lasts.

Row.SpeakerTwo: Do not remind it that we are here.

Row.SpeakerTwo: Then it would stop being special.

Row.SpeakerOne: I am fine.

Row.SpeakerOne: Still here.

Row.SpeakerOne: Give me a second.
Row.SpeakerTwo: Take the whole turn.

Row.SpeakerOne: I had it under control.
Row.SpeakerTwo: Your flashing health bar disagrees.

Row.SpeakerOne: I promised I would not disappear.
Row.SpeakerTwo: Keep promising.

Row.SpeakerTwo: Then let us keep moving.

Row.SpeakerTwo: I just took the long way around.

Row.SpeakerOne: How long has it been?
Row.SpeakerTwo: Long enough that this counts as a reunion.

Row.SpeakerOne: Same lobby?
Row.SpeakerTwo: Same lobby. Different century.

Row.SpeakerOne: {OTHER}?
Row.SpeakerTwo: You still recognise the username.

Row.SpeakerOne: You missed a lot.
Row.SpeakerTwo: Start from the last thing we both remember.

Row.SpeakerOne: I was not sure what to say when I found you.
Row.SpeakerTwo: You did not have to say anything.

Row.SpeakerOne: Of all places, {LOCATION}.
Row.SpeakerTwo: We always did meet in strange lobbies.

Row.SpeakerOne: Promise we will not lose each other again.
Row.SpeakerTwo: Promise we will keep finding each other.
